notes.title: New release! Get WRECKIN' BALL ADVENTURE! 30% OFF now!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30881076/b976def2bac5caf32a3e58032b84f27202f8f612.jpg

Hello everyone!

We are very happy to announce WRECKIN' BALL ADVENTURE - a brand new release by No Gravity Games!

Wreckin' Ball Adventure is a family-friendly platformer for up to 4 players, with ball-shaped robots and physics-based puzzles. 
You are a ball to jump, swing and wreck your way to freedom!

Get it 30% OFF now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/746030/Wreckin_Ball_Adventure/

BTW, for all Nintendo Switch fans, the game is also available: https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/wreckin-ball-adventure-switch/

notes.title: Dream Alone - new update [08.12.2017]
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30881076/4e5d355ae463a89f74a0c34fb93dddc82690e4a1.jpg
Hello!

We're happy to announce that Dream Alone got a new build!
Patch notes:
Design of game world no. 6 + sound setting
Load/Save system
Outro animation
Voice over recordings

Want to know more about Dream Alone? Add it to your Steam wishlist and check regularly for new updates and announcements!
